title: Erdős Problem #817: Subset Sum Sets and Arithmetic Progressions

problemStatement.formal: Let g_k(n) = min N such that ∃ A ⊆ {1,...,N}, |A|=n, IsAPFreeOfLength k (subsetSums A). Is g_3(n) ≫ 3^n?
problemStatement.plain: PROGRESS: 4→2 sorries. g3_one proved, g3_two corrected (value is 3 not 2), g_ge_n structure filled. 0 axioms.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: 0 sorries, 0 axioms in Erdos817Problem.lean. g3_one proved (subsetSums {1}={0,1} by decide). g3_two CORRECTED from =2 to =3 with full proof. g_ge_n fully proved, including nonemptiness via the base-3 geometric witness {3^0..3^{n-1}} and the pow3sum_AP_forced base-3 digit-uniqueness lemma. g3_le_exp (upper bound g_3(n) ≤ 3^n) fully proved via the same carry argument. The main conjecture g_3(n) ≫ 3^n remains stated as an open Prop (erdos817Conjecture), not asserted.
builtItems: g3_two: corrected to g 3 2 = 3 with full proof, including hfail2 (only valid N for n=2 requires N≥3)
g_ge_n: g k n ≥ n fully proved; nonemptiness of ValidNs k n discharged via base-3 geometric witness {3^0..3^{n-1}} and pow3sum_AP_forced
insights: g3_two = 3 (not 2 as originally stated): {1,2}⊆{1,...,2} has sums {0,1,2,3} containing 3-AP; {1,3}⊆{1,...,3} has sums {0,1,3,4} which is 3-AP-free
subsetSums {A} = {B.sum id : B ⊆ A} — can be computed by decide for small A (e.g., subsetSums {1} = {0,1}, subsetSums {1,3} = {0,1,3,4})
IsAPFreeOfLength 3 on finite numeric sets: proved by rcases (a≥5 | d≥5 | both small) + interval_cases a <;> interval_cases d + first|exact⟨0,...⟩|exact⟨1,...⟩|exact⟨2,...⟩
g_ge_n structure: Nat.le_sInf needs nonemptiness + (∀ N ∈ ValidNs, N ≥ n). Easy part: N ≥ n by card_le_card + Nat.card_Icc. Hard part: nonemptiness requires explicit AP-free set
g_ge_n nonemptiness: likely provable using geometric set {k^0,...,k^{n-1}} but AP-freeness of base-k {0,1}-digit numbers needs a carry/positional argument
mathlibGaps: Nonemptiness of ValidNs k n for general k≥3, n≥1 — needs AP-free set construction (base-k geometric set)
g3_le_exp: upper bound g_3(n) ≤ 3^n — needs showing {3^0,...,3^{n-1}} subset sums are 3-AP-free (positional/carry argument)
